newsitem.title: USA: Vectra Banking declares 3-for-2 stk split.
newsitem.headline: Vectra Banking declares 3-for-2 stk split.

text.p: Vectra Banking Corp said Thursday it declared a 3-for-2 split of its common stock, payable May 30, to shareholders of record May 15.
Each shareholder will receive an additional 50 shares of common stock for every 100 shares currently owned. A cash payment will be made in lieu of fractional shares.

Vectra Bank currently has 3,202,412 shares outstanding and will have 4,803,618 shares outstanding after the new shares are issued. The terms of all outstanding warrants, options, and convertible preferred stock will be adjusted to reflect the 3-for-2 stock split.
